# Refinzi 2.1.0 — Browser-Native AI Prompt Layer

> Refinzi is a free browser extension that rewrites rough prompts in-place inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity. Write naturally. Click the Orb for a Better prompt, or hold it for an Expert one. No forms. No prompt engineering. No questions.

## Quick Summary
- **Platform**: Browser extension (Manifest V3) for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox.
- **Core Workflow**: Click the Refinzi Orb that docks beside the composer to get an instantly refined prompt — applied in-place.
- **Secondary Workflow**: Hold the Orb (350ms) to trigger deep, autonomous Expert-calibration with zero questions.
- **Privacy & Security**: Zero prompt storage. On-device synthesis engine by default. Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and OpenRouter over HTTPS.
- **Pricing**: 100% Free forever. No subscriptions, no paywalls.

## Key Links
- [Official Website](https://refinzi.com): Main product hub and interactive demo.

## Supported AI Sites
Refinzi works natively inside the composer of:
- ChatGPT (chatgpt.com)
- Claude (claude.ai)
- Google Gemini (gemini.google.com)
- Perplexity (perplexity.ai)

## Core Architecture
1. **User writes naturally** into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity.
2. **Click Orb (< 350ms) → ⚡ Better Prompt**: Refinzi understands the actual task, identifies high-value missing dimensions, and calibrates the instruction in-place.
3. **Hold Orb (≥ 350ms) → 🧠 Expert Prompt**: Refinzi performs deep task reconstruction (Understand → Infer → Assume → Execute), producing a senior-practitioner-level briefing. Never asks the user questions.
4. **Automatic In-Place Replacement**: The prompt is automatically replaced directly inside the AI composer. A floating [↩ Undo] toast preserves the original draft.

## Supported Providers
- **Built-in Engine**: On-device synthesis with zero API keys.
- **Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK)**: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter — dispatched from the background service worker, never visible to the host page.
